requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement, incorporating the mandatory precondition from the controlled context (BR-01).

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: a window of the car is damaged AND (the interior surveillance detects an intruder OR a door of the car is opened without a car key)

structured_requirements.final_statement: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder or a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.
structuring_notes: The structure reflects the logical combination of conditions (Window Damage AND (Intruder OR Door Opened)).
The mandatory precondition 'Window damage is a mandatory precondition for triggering the alarm' (BR-01) is incorporated into the condition clause.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the exact mechanism or timing of the alarm raising, only the trigger condition.
